aviso_sintetico: Local test configuration. Identities and backups are declared. This does not grant permissions or run backups or deletions.
argumentos_invalidos: Specify the register, all roots to be restored and the text catalogue. See the examples in the manual.
catalogo_invalido: The catalogue could not be read. Select a complete catalogue and try again.
politica_entrada_invalida: Check the dates, time zone and policy values. The window must end on the same day.
politica_version_distinta: The policy changed. Read the current version and review your proposal before saving it.
politica_historia_invalida: The history does not match the expected register. Stop changes and ask Systems to review the register.
politica_denegada: The change was not authorized. Check current permission and another person's review when required.
politica_dependencia_pendiente: The operation could not be completed. Check the external register and required services before retrying.
politica_fuera_ventana: The date does not identify an execution within the current window. Read the schedule again.
salida_fallida: The result could not be written. Read the register before repeating a change.
previa_activa: Kept because it protects an active restoration.
pendiente_conciliacion: Kept until the pending operation is reconciled.
dependencia_necesaria: Kept because another backup depends on it.
no_verificada: Deletion is not proposed without verification.
minimo_verificadas: Kept to maintain the minimum number of verified backups.
dentro_retencion: Kept within the configured retention period.
borrado_no_permitido: The policy does not allow deletion proposals.
candidata_revision: May be reviewed for deletion. Current authorization and the configured control are required before any effect.
fuera_destino: The backup belongs to another destination; this policy does not apply.
politica_aviso_fallido: Execution failed and the notification could not be emitted. Ask Systems to review the register before retrying.
